title: Text Display Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Text Display plugin - displays custom scrolling or static text messages

enabled.description: Enable or disable the text display plugin

display_duration.description: How long to display the text in seconds (for non-scrolling or one complete scroll cycle)

update_interval.description: How often to refresh the text display in seconds

text.description: The text message to display on the LED matrix

font_mode.description: Font sizing mode. 'manual' uses font_path/font_size as configured. 'auto' picks the largest crisp font that fits the display: static text is sized to fit the panel, scrolling text is sized to the panel height.

font_path.description: Path to font file (TTF or BDF format). Relative to project root or absolute path. Used in manual font mode.

font_size.description: Font size in pixels. Used in manual font mode.

scroll.description: Enable scrolling animation for text. If false, text is displayed statically.

scroll_speed.description: Pixels moved per scroll step. Speed is scroll_speed / scroll_delay pixels per second (default 1 / 0.01 = 100 px/s), moved to the nearest speed the panel can draw in whole pixels.

scroll_delay.description: Seconds per scroll step. Speed is scroll_speed / scroll_delay pixels per second, so a smaller delay scrolls faster.

target_fps.description: Deprecated — no longer used: nothing reads it, so it never changed the scroll speed. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs.
target_fps.title: Target FPS (deprecated)

scroll_loop.description: If true, text loops continuously. If false, scrolls once and stops (one-shot mode).

scroll_gap_width.description: Gap width in pixels between scroll loops (space between end and start of text when looping)
